relationships.subject: TRP channels
relationships.evidence_quote: Endothelial cells of the blood-brain barrier (BBB) express TRP channels such as TRP vanilloid 1-4 and are involved in thermal detection by regulating BBB permeability.

relationships.subject: TRP channels
relationships.evidence_quote: In neurological disorders, TRP channels in the BBB are responsible for edema formation in the brain.

key_findings: Review: BBB endothelial TRPV1-4 channels regulate BBB permeability and contribute to brain edema in neurological disorders.
